summary: DRA_CAPITAL_RELEASE_REBALANCING_BRANCH_CLOSE. Both exact sealed pre-2025 studies have qualified_count=0, selected_candidate=null and terminal NO_CANDIDATE status. Flat-veto cooldown V2B produced a real within-study 2022 route-substitution repair, but whole-Validation total PnL was lower and drawdown was higher than its router V2 parent, failing the frozen economic gates. One-slot rotation removed terminal inventory and increased marked Validation total PnL, but realized PnL was lower, drawdown and median holding were worse, and annual drawdown non-worse breadth was only 2 of 5, failing its frozen gates. Absolute PnL was neither ranked nor added across the 250-USDT router and 30-USDT one-slot studies. Close the DRA_CAPITAL_RELEASE_REBALANCING mechanism family without tuning a rescue variant. Immediate PnL and drawdown effects are zero.
